reviews.comment:
Increíble que cuando un playero te atiende bien y querés dejarle una propina , que te ofrecen la posibilidad de hacerlo por ejemplo con Mercado Pago, nunca le llegue al empleado. Yo no le quiero dejar al ACA sepa quiero dejar al playero. Una vergüenza. Quien se queda con algo que no le corresponde?. Tener que solicitarle al empleado su alias para dejarle una propina teniendo la opción con QR? Una vergüenza. En fin. Son patéticos por no decir otra cosa. Horribles.

(Translated by Google)
It's unbelievable that when a gas station attendant gives you good service and you want to leave a tip, even though they offer the option to do so with Mercado Pago, for example, the employee never receives it. I don't want to leave a tip for the gas station attendant; I want to leave one for the attendant. It's a disgrace. Who's keeping something that doesn't belong to them? Having to ask the employee for their username to leave a tip when there's a QR code option? It's shameful. In short, they're pathetic, to say the least. Horrible.

reviews.comment:
Hoy estuve cargando nafta en esta Ypf y el playero me preguntó como paga y si era socio del acá le dije que si, me pidió el celular para anotar el número de socio y le dije que no le tenía porque entregar mi celular a lo que me contestó bájese del auto y me da el número me bajé y le dije que él tenía que anotarlo y no yo bajarme del auto a lo cual me contestó que él no tenía que hacer eso me parece que uno no tiene porque entregar el celular salgo personal además están ahí también las tarjetas de crédito que pésimo servicio y todavía me discutía

(Translated by Google)
Today I was filling up at this YPF station and the attendant asked me how I was paying and if I was a member. I said yes, and he asked for my cell phone to write down my membership number. I told him I didn't have to give him my phone, to which he replied, "Get out of the car and give me the number." I got out and told him that he was supposed to write it down, not me. He replied that he didn't have to do that. I don't think anyone should have to hand over their cell phone; it's personal. Besides, they also accept credit cards there. What terrible service! And he was still arguing with me.
